source_records.title: Evaluations overview (6 plans)
source_records.short_quote: Six plans; safety net; $25K sim cap; LIVE ELITE.
source_records.notes: Plan comparison table: drawdown styles, DLL, sizes. Shared rules: 5 min days (3 Fast Track), $47 reset, safety net = DD+$100, sim split up to 100%, $25K/trader sim cap, LIVE ELITE 80/20.

source_records.title: 1 Step Evaluation plan page
source_records.short_quote: Live trailing; no DLL; 50K/100K/250K; $47 resets.
source_records.notes: 50K $2,000 DD/$3,000 target/8 minis; 100K $3,000/$6,000/14; 250K $6,500/$15,000/24. Live trailing follows highest unrealized P&L incl open positions. No DLL. 5 min days. $47 resets unlimited. Flatten 1 min before close. 1 mini = 10 micros. Max withdrawal/cycle up to $3,000.

source_records.title: End of Day Evaluation plan page
source_records.short_quote: EOD trailing; hard-breach DLL $1,100/$2,200; 50K/100K.
source_records.notes: 50K: $2,000 EOD DD, $1,100 DLL, $3,000 target, 8 minis. 100K: $3,500 EOD DD, $2,200 DLL, $6,000 target, 14 minis. DLL touch = immediate fail. TradeShield converts to soft breach. No consistency rule. Flatten 1 min before close; no overnight.

source_records.title: Static Drawdown plan page
source_records.short_quote: Static fixed floor; 10K/25K/50K; no DLL; no consistency.
source_records.notes: 10K $500/$1,000 target/1 mini; 25K $1,000/$2,000/2; 50K $2,000/$4,000/4. Floor fixed day one; breach if account closes at or below floor. No DLL, no consistency rule. $47 resets. Flatten 1 min before close.

source_records.title: Fast Track Evaluation plan page
source_records.short_quote: 10K; EOD or Static $500; $2,000 target; no resets.
source_records.notes: Single 10K, two variants (EOD trailing / $500 static), $2,000 target, 1 mini/10 micros, no DLL, 3 min trading days, no resets, one free month funded activation. Flatten 1 min before close. CONFLICTS with revamped help article on time limit.

source_records.title: Diamond Hands plan page
source_records.short_quote: 100K; EOD trailing; $1,500 DLL; overnight+weekend holds.
source_records.notes: 100K: $3,500 EOD DD, $1,500 DLL hard breach, $5,000 target, 2 minis/20 micros. Only eval plan permitting overnight and weekend holds. News/release holds not blocked. $47 resets.

source_records.title: Direct to Funded plan page
source_records.short_quote: DTF one-time; 10K/50K/100K; no eval; no DLL.
source_records.notes: 10K Mini Inferno: $1,500 EOD DD, $1,600 safety net, 2 minis/2 micros. 50K: $5,000 EOD DD, $5,100 safety net, 5/5. 100K: $5,000 fixed DD, $5,100 safety net, 3/3. 1 mini = 1 micro. No DLL. Overnight/weekend holds OK. First payout after 5/15/20 ATDs. Max withdrawal/cycle up to $5,000.

source_records.title: Payouts page
source_records.short_quote: Up to 100% sim split; $25K cap; LIVE ELITE 80/20.
source_records.notes: Per-cycle min $100; max scales by size/cycle (50K: $100-$1,250 cycle 1 toward $2,000 later). ATD 8 first cycle / 10 after (standard); DTF 5/10/15/20 by size. $25,000 cumulative sim payouts per trader -> LIVE ELITE: 80/20, uncapped, daily withdrawals business days, $250 min, 48h approval guarantee. Paid via Rise ACH/crypto. Same-day approval. Platforms: TradingView, NinjaTrader, Tradovate, Quantower, Sierra Chart, MotiveWave.

source_records.title: Elite Sim-Funded page
source_records.short_quote: Activation $87/mo or one-time from $177; $150K lifetime cap.
source_records.notes: Activation: $87/month or one-time lifetime from $177 (varies by size/plan). Double Down Deal from $47. Professional traders $128/exchange market-data fee. $150,000 lifetime sim cap across re-entries. 50K example: $50,100 min balance, $52,100 safety net.

source_records.title: Help: Elite account fees
source_records.short_quote: One-time fee table by size/plan; $87 monthly; DTF none.
source_records.notes: One-time activation: <=75K $177 (1-Step/EOD/Static); 100K-150K $247/$257/$177/$307 (1-Step/EOD/Static/DH); 250K+ $277 (1-Step). Fast Track ineligible for one-time; first month free then $87/mo. DTF no activation fee. Monthly $87 for all Elite Sim-Funded.

source_records.title: Help: Consistency Rule and ATD
source_records.short_quote: ATD $250 + 30% best day (post Oct 2 2026); DTF table.
source_records.notes: Evals purchased on/after 2026-10-02 2PM PT: ATD = >=$250 realized AND >=30% of best day ($125 min for 10K/25K Static). Before: $200 + 23% ($100 min for small sizes). 8 ATDs cycle 1, 10 cycles 2-4. DTF: 10K 5 ATDs/$150/50%, 25K 10/$300/38%, 50K 15/$600/62%, 100K 20/$500/50%. Revamped Fast Track: 40% qualify / 30% at reward; ATD $100 (EOD/Static) or $200 (Live Trailing). ATDs need not be consecutive.

source_records.title: Help: Revamped Fast-Track plan
source_records.short_quote: 10 calendar day limit; 40% consistency; loss-limit rule.
source_records.notes: Revamped Fast Track: pass within 10 calendar days or auto-fail (no reset/renewal). 40% consistency to qualify; 30% at reward. Sunday+Monday = same day. Must trade current highest-volume contract. Elite Sim-Funded: safety net locks floor at start balance+$100 (static unchanged); loss-limit rule: after 20% profit, losing >35% of accumulated profit removes account from Elite program; Elite reset up to 10x (DTF incl). Reward approval daily Mon-Fri from 3PM ET; cut-offs Fri 5PM ET -> Monday batch, Tue 5PM ET -> Wednesday batch. Sim rewards Mon+Wed; Live Elite daily. Cycle max must be fully withdrawn before advancing. Reward structures: 10K EOD $500/$750/$1000 cap $2,250; 10K Static $750/$1000/$1250 cap $3,000. KYC + Rise onboarding. LIVE ELITE transition at ETF discretion.

source_records.title: Help: Max Active Elite Sim-Funded Accounts
source_records.short_quote: Up to 20 active funded; max 5 DTF; approved copiers only.
source_records.notes: Evals purchased on/after 2025-09-17: up to 20 active Elite Sim-Funded accounts (Fast Track counts); max 5 of 20 can be DTF. Only ETF-approved trade copiers across multiple accounts.

source_records.title: Policy: Hedging against yourself
source_records.short_quote: Self-hedge banned incl same household; suspension/termination.
source_records.notes: Hedging against oneself with same or correlated instrument (e.g. NQ and MNQ) across one or multiple accounts strictly prohibited, incl accounts in same household/address. Violation -> suspension/termination, gains void.

source_records.title: Trade Copier, EA & Algo disclaimer
source_records.short_quote: EA/algo need written auth; approved copiers listed.
source_records.notes: AI/bots/EAs/algo require express written authorization; only authorized automated tools are the approved copiers: Tradesyncer, Tradecopia, Affordable Indicators, Replikanto Flowbot (compliance edition), platform built-ins. Violation: reset, profit forfeiture, ban.

source_records.title: Help: Tradable instruments
source_records.short_quote: Futures only; full symbol/commission table; MNQ $0.51/side.
source_records.notes: US futures only. Forex, equities, options (incl options on futures) not permitted. Per-side commissions incl MNQ $0.51, NQ $2.04, ES $2.04, MES $0.56, MGC $0.76, GC $2.31, CL $2.26, MCL $0.76.

source_records.title: Help: 30-day login + weekly trade policy
source_records.short_quote: 30-day login all; weekly trade funded only; profits forfeited.
source_records.notes: Login >= once per 30 days (all users). Elite Sim-Funded: >=1 valid trade per calendar week; evaluations exempt. Non-compliance: account disabled/closed, profits/credits forfeited. Exceptions via support ticket / self-serve form in advance.

source_records.title: VPN and IP-masking policy
source_records.short_quote: VPN/proxy/VPS banned; only approved partner IP ranges.
source_records.notes: VPNs, proxies, VPS, IP-masking banned on trading accounts; violation of ToS; can mean reset, profit forfeiture, failure, permanent ban. Exception: approved partner services in approved IP ranges (e.g. approved trade copiers).

source_records.title: Refund policy
source_records.short_quote: No refunds; chargeback = ban; satisfaction guarantee exception.
source_records.notes: No returns/refunds/exchanges for any reason once billed. Exception: 100% Satisfaction Guarantee (first purchase). Chargebacks investigated; user barred from future purchases; fraudulent chargebacks -> deactivation, earnings revoked.

source_records.title: Help: Countries restricted/supported
source_records.short_quote: Eligibility by residence; Rise-restricted list; Stripe list.
source_records.notes: Eligibility by country of residence. OFAC-sanctioned cannot get live broker approval. Country must be supported by both Rise and Stripe. KYC + Rise signup required; details must match. Rise-restricted (21): Afghanistan, CAR, Congo (Brazzaville), Cuba, DRC, Guinea, Haiti, Iran, Iraq, Libya, Mali, Myanmar, North Korea, Russia, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Syria, Ukraine, Venezuela, Yemen. US territories Guam/Puerto Rico/USVI unsupported. Stripe-supported list incl Hong Kong, US, UK, Singapore etc.

source_records.title: Terms of Service
source_records.short_quote: Contract with Elite Trader Funding LLC; effective 2026-10-08.
source_records.notes: Binding contract between user and Elite Trader Funding LLC. AI/bots/automated strategies need written authorization. ETF may transition trader to Live Elite before/during/after a reward request.

source_records.title: Pricing cards (official marketing)
source_records.short_quote: Static 10K $147/mo; 1-Step 50K $197/mo; DTF 50K $747.
source_records.notes: Advertised: Static 10K $147/mo (target $1,000, 1 mini, $500 DD, 5 days, 8 qualified days, $47 reset, activation $87/mo or $177 one-time). 1-Step 50K $197/mo (target $3,000, 8 minis, $2,000 max loss, $47 reset, activation $87/$177). DTF 50K $747 one-time (target $5,100, 5 minis, $5,000 EOD DD, 15 qualified days, $297 reset, max 5 active accounts/user). All: same-day payout approval, up to 100% sim split, cancel anytime, 100% satisfaction guarantee first purchase.

source_records.title: Help: How the 1-Step plan works
source_records.short_quote: Funded trailing until safety net; no hedging; Elite reset 10x.
source_records.notes: Elite Sim-Funded: trailing drawdown follows highest unrealized profit until safety net (max DD + $100 realized); then floor locks at start balance + $100 permanently. No hedging (same/correlated across accounts). Position caps per size. Breach -> failed, no rewards; Elite reset up to 10 times or new evaluation.
